map.按行对比两段文本，高亮显示新增、删除与修改内容。: Compare two texts line by line and highlight added, deleted and modified content
map.文本差异按行比对：以行为单位做最长公共子序列匹配，未匹配的行为新增或删除；行内再: Text diff compares line by line: it matches by longest common subsequence per line; unmatched lines are added or deleted; within a line a character-level diff marks the modified segments; similarity = 2 × matched lines ÷ (original line count + new line count) × 100%; additions are highlighted green, deletions red, modifications yellow, for quickly locating changes between two versions.
map.新增：文本 B 中有但 A 中没有的行。: Added: lines present in text B but not in A.
map.删除：文本 A 中有但 B 中没有的行。: Deleted: lines present in text A but not in B.
map.修改文案或代码后，把旧版贴到 A、新版贴到 B，立刻看清哪些行被新增、哪些被删除: After revising copy or code, paste the old version into A and the new version into B to immediately see which lines were added, deleted or kept unchanged.
map.对比两份合同/条款/配置的差异，定位改动点，避免漏看关键修订。: Compare the differences between two contracts / clauses / configurations, locate the change points, and avoid missing key revisions.
map.代码评审或翻译校对中，确认译文与原文段落是否一一对应，发现遗漏或多余段落。: In code review or translation proofreading, confirm whether the translated paragraphs correspond one to one with the source, and find omitted or extra paragraphs.
map.A=“我爱北京”，B=“我爱上海”：工具按最长公共子序列（LCS）比对，标记“我: A="I love Beijing", B="I love Shanghai": the tool compares by longest common subsequence (LCS), marks "I" "love" as the same, the old "Beijing" as deleted and the new "Shanghai" as added — the difference position is clear at a glance.
map.差异比对是基于行还是字符？: Is the diff based on lines or characters?
map.本工具按行切分后做 LCS 比对，因此段落/行级别改动最清晰；单行内字符级差异不: This tool splits by line and then does LCS comparison, so paragraph / line-level changes are the clearest; character-level differences within a single line are not marked character by character.
map.为什么有些相同内容被标成新增？: Why are some identical contents marked as added?
map.、首尾空格、不可见字符（如全角/半角空格）不同都会导致行被判定为不一致，建议比对: Leading/trailing spaces and invisible characters (such as full-width / half-width spaces) being different will cause a line to be judged inconsistent; it is recommended to unify line breaks and indentation before comparing.
